dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: The mortal temptations stopped the truth in its tracks, denying the verdict of my victory the chance to be announced in my presence.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Wow, I'm surprised you have the nerve to bring that up again.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: #You and Oz are like two peas in a pod, trying desperately to convince {NICKNAME} and Paimon that you were the victor. I hardly see how that's fair.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Besides, only the loser would want to get—

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein, she means to say that you are the loser.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Ahem... Lady Megistus, let us put aside the sacred matter of our trial for now. Once I have reclaimed my throne in the Immernachtreich, we shall settle this for good in the Garten Sanssouci!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Oh, that's fine by me, I'll beat you no matter how many times you ask for a rematch... wait, but what is that place, exactly?
